purpose: Map already-frozen independent Q/D return fragments into six analytical slots without exposing C wording or changing either return.
preconditions: Q and D return files both exist.
each return has freeze.output_sha256 and freeze.frozen_at.
the Q/D cross-review validator returns READY_FOR_CROSS_REVIEW before this adapter runs.

output_per_reviewer.normalization: NFKC and punctuation-stripped forms may be added only as parallel comparison fields; verbatim_fragment is immutable.
output_per_reviewer.missing_rule: Absence is NOT_OBSERVED or NOT_IN_REVIEW_SCOPE, never an invented fragment.

decision_rule: Only post-freeze comparison may consult the C projection. Any reviewer disagreement, scope gap, or unresolved character remains HOLD and is not repaired by C.
next_checkpoint: After Q/D freeze and READY_FOR_CROSS_REVIEW, generate two immutable per-reviewer slot projections, compare them, then compare the preserved differences with the C projection.
